connectorUiConfig.title: Cybereinforce (via Codeless Connector Platform)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [Cybereinforce](https://cybereinforce.com) connector brings events from every Cybereinforce product into Microsoft Sentinel: Browser protection (URL blocks, threat-intelligence matches, devices, rules), Email Security (inbox decisions, quarantine), Host Enforcement, Brand Protection and platform audit events. The Product column tells them apart. Microsoft Sentinel collects new events every 5 minutes with your Cybereinforce MicrosoftToken, the only value you enter.

sampleQueries.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

CybereinforceCTE_CL
| summarize Events = count() by Product

sampleQueries.description: URL blocks matched to Cybereinforce Threat Intelligence
sampleQueries.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where EventType == "block.url"
| extend d = parse_json(Details)
| where tobool(d.ioc) == true
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where Product == "EmailSecurity"
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where tolower(Severity) in ("high", "critical")
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: CybereinforceCTE_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: Cybereinforce MicrosoftToken
customs.description: Generated by a Cybereinforce Tenant Administrator in the admin console: Deployment -> Tokens & Deployment -> Integrations - MicrosoftToken.

parameters.content:
#### 1. Get your Cybereinforce MicrosoftToken
   1.1. Sign in to the [Cybereinforce admin console](https://cybereinforce.com/admin/) as a Tenant Administrator.
   1.2. Open **Deployment -> Tokens & Deployment**, find **Integrations - MicrosoftToken** and click **Generate MicrosoftToken**.
   1.3. Click **Copy MicrosoftToken**. The token identifies your tenant, so no tenant ID is needed.

#### 2. Connect
 To start collecting, click **Add new instance**, paste the MicrosoftToken and click **Connect**. The first events appear within about 30 minutes.
